description: Nothing younger than 7 days gets in, whoever updates: Renovate's minimumReleaseAge gates its own updates (npm, PyPI, GitHub Actions), but not lockfile maintenance, which re-resolves each lockfile with its package manager's own gate: pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and uv's exclude-newer (pyproject.toml). flake.lock has no such gate, so its monthly update is a PR to review.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once the tests pass on their branch.
Majors only when approved on the dependency dashboard, and never automatically.
wrangler and friends release several times a week: once a month is plenty.
The browser voice stack and sign-in: always a PR to review, never grouped with the rest.
nixpkgs moves with no age gate (the toolchain: uv, Node, pnpm): a PR to review, not an automerge.
